funds_data.description: The index measures the performance of 100 leading dividend-paying emerging market companies, selected according to indicated annual dividend yield, subject to screening and buffering criteria and weighting constraints. Under normal circumstances, the fund will not invest less than 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in components of its underlying index.
